provisioner.description: Not used by the priority class templates. Only set in the priority class fixture of common-test.

preemptionPolicy.description: Whether pods of this class may preempt lower priority pods.

enabled.description: Create this priority class when true. Accepts a Helm `tpl` string that renders to `true` or `false`.

namespace.description: Namespace to create this object in. Overrides the chart-wide `namespace` and `global.namespace`.

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels

value.description: Priority value of the class. A higher value means a higher priority.

globalDefault.description: Use this class for pods that set no priority class. Only one class in the cluster can be the default.
